content.title: Alley Cat Encounter | Follow Route, Crouched Contact and Shared Exit
content.summary: An adult bookbinder pauses in a passage for one cat greeting and resumes with it beside her. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult subject, one route and one animal remain continuous. + The encounter interrupts an already established travel direction. + Approach precedes contact and contact occurs only once. + The reaction remains small and physically plausible. + The original route resumes with both participants accounted for.
quick_start.recommended_input: Track one original adult bookbinder from behind through a warm stone passage, walking toward a turquoise gate. She crouches without changing location, opens one hand at knee height and lets the cat close the distance. She stands, resumes walking toward the turquoise gate and lets the same cat accompany her beside the right leg.

The encounter interrupts an already established travel direction.
The reaction remains small and physically plausible.
The original route resumes with both participants accounted for.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.

creative_dna.mechanism: 从背后跟随同一成年人物穿过窄巷，猫的出现中断路线；人物停下、蹲低、伸手并完成一次抚摸，随后起身按原方向继续行走，猫在脚边同行。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult subject, one route and one animal remain continuous.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult subject, one route and one animal remain continuous."

invariants.rule: The encounter interrupts an already established travel direction.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The encounter interrupts an already established travel direction."

invariants.rule: Approach precedes contact and contact occurs only once.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Approach precedes contact and contact occurs only once."

invariants.rule: The reaction remains small and physically plausible.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The reaction remains small and physically plausible."

invariants.rule: The original route resumes with both participants accounted for.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The original route resumes with both participants accounted for."
